text:
Zara Ahmed: hi team 44b first day in product-design — quick blockers: 1) i get a 403 on the "Redwood UI Library" Figma file, 2) which Notion page is the canonical roadmap (i found two copies), and 3) where's the research playbook / how do i request participants?
June Park: welcome Zara!! Figma email? i'll add you to the org and the library. canonical roadmap is Notion > Product > Roadmaps > Live. the other copy is an older draft.
Zara Ahmed: zara.ahmed@redwood.ai thanks June
design-ops-bot: Welcome Zara! New hire checklist: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync + #design-ops 3) Read Product Roadmap (Notion) 4) Read Research Playbook + request Maze/Lookback seats. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
June Park: invite sent, you should get a Figma email. if still blocked try the invite link or DM me.
Marco Silva: tagging in re roadmap  hey Zara, main roadmap link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/product-roadmap-live. we snapshot weekly and tag PRDs in "In Review". leave comments on the roadmap page for timeline questions.
Zara Ahmed: got the Figma invite 389 thanks! Marco  can you point me to recent study transcripts? i'd like to read last 3 synths and shadow a session this week if possible.
Ravi Das: hey Zara 44b Research Playbook is Product > Research in Notion. transcripts and recordings link from each study page (internal S3). lightweight studies use the short form and can be triaged same-day on Thu. i'll add you as an observer to Friday's interview.
June Park: for Maze/Lookback seats file the Maze form (forms.redwood.ai/maze-request) and Lookback via the playbook. design-ops approves Maze quickly for new hires.
Zara Ahmed: awesome — one more: tokens. i'm experimenting with syncing spacing tokens from Figma to code. who issues plugin keys and what's the safe experiment flow to avoid touching prod tokens?
Marco Silva: tokens live in the Design System file and a tokens doc in Notion. workflow: export to a draft branch via the plugin, open a PR labeled "experiment/tokens". merges to main require eng-platform signoff + visual-diff. request a scoped test key via Notion > Design > Plugin Keys and tag @Marco Silva for platform review.
Ravi Das: small change in a feature file is fine; any publish to the shared library needs the token checklist: update changelog, run visual-diff (Percy), and a 15m review. breaking renames need a migration note.
Zara Ahmed: thanks. also curious who manages stipend budget for participants?
June Park: design-ops manages up to $500 per study; larger budgets go through research-ops and finance. put the budget ask in the recruiting form and we'll route it.
Marco Silva: bonus tip: we publish short 2-3 line research summaries to #product-research after each study — good to read for quick context.
Zara Ahmed: perfect, appreciate it. please add me to the design pairing and critique invites and i'll start reading the roadmap + recent synths tonight.
June Park: will add you to Tue pairing and Wed critique. ping here if anything else blocks access.
Ravi Das: welcome aboard Zara 680 excited to have you on the team!
